description: List scans whose screenshot has this perceptual hash (hash_type ahash, phash, dhash, whash, color_hash or crop_resistant), optionally within similarity_threshold, each with URL, title and time; paginated. Useful for finding pages that look the same.

hash_type.description: Kind of screenshot hash: ahash, phash, dhash, whash, color_hash or crop_resistant.
hash_type.title: Hash Type

hash_value.description: Screenshot hash to find, any case: 16 hex characters for ahash, phash, dhash and whash, or 11 hex digits for color_hash.
hash_value.title: Hash Value

similarity_threshold.description: Largest Hamming distance for a similar match (ahash, phash, dhash and whash only); omit for exact matches.
similarity_threshold.title: Similarity Threshold

name: search_by_screenshot_hash
title: Search By Screenshot Hash
